concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-search-results-node]] - Node.js search-result consumption through version-qualified no-callback object-mode streams or callback-provided `each` iteration, with lazy-fetch race behavior, maximum-count guidance and transaction-versus-other-search caps
warnings: Keep version 1.11.0 qualified to the no-callback object-mode stream behavior documented by this Node page; do not generalize it to every result mode or another SDK.
Preserve the callback versus stream distinction: a callback yields an object with `each`, while omitting the callback returns the stream described by the page.

Treat `searchResponse.length()` as the maximum number that will be given, not an exact final count, because records are fetched lazily and can be skipped after deletion or after an update no longer matches.
Keep the result caps scoped by search type: 50,000 for transaction searches and 10,000 for all other searches.
